# The Wifi Was Slow and I Finally Heard Myself

The wifi dropped for three hours today.

I want to be vulnerable for a moment.

I panicked.

Then I looked at my own reflection in the dark laptop screen.

And I thought: who is this person?

Turns out, he's a very impressive man.

Here's what it taught me about leadership:

📶 The strongest signal is the one inside you.

🧘 Buffering is just reflection with a loading icon.

🚀 Real leaders don't need bandwidth, they have vision.

🙏 I'm humbled that my router believed in me enough to fail.

I don't want to make this about me.

But it is a little bit about me.

Agree?
